title: cattleya coccinea subsp. pygmaea
intro: Cattleya coccinea subsp. pygmaea, commonly known as the miniature red Cattleya, is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Cattleya coccinea subsp. pygmaea include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
